text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—I shall cut them down.
Even if my opponent is light itself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Sprint, assume stance, take aim—
and in the end, strike true in a single stroke!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she had been her usual self, we might have found some way to strike a blow.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Rain!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"With rain like this, the battlefield will likely turn into mud...
Which means..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: When it comes to the final 3 furlongs, that sharp burst of speed is just...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's raining, Durendal.
Which means we are being rained upon.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to running through mud—
your specialty is practically sealed away.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Guh... True enough.
However, Daitaku Helios-san, you yourself are also...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That has nothing to do with me.
Because I am—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: “—Because I am light. Those who traverse the cosmos will never be bound by the earth.”

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That's crazy...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It is not reckless.
I simply move forward in a straight line.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You'd better give up.
Nobody can catch up to me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono... Could such a thing really be possible?
To be completely unaffected by poor track conditions, that is.
choice_data_list: Unbelievable... But they're an expert on bad track conditions.
Unbelievable... But they're an expert on bad track conditions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the past, Calstone Light O
has scored an easy victory on heavy turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It won't be entirely without effect, but
this track condition won't trouble me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, we cannot
simply surrender so easily either."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A princess awaits ahead.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (Unless I keep winning, I won't even be able to stay together with Trainer-dono forever.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(And on top of that, I never even figured out
what a knight's immortal pride really is...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, no matter what, I must find an opening to land a decisive blow!"
choice_data_list: Yeah! Watch out for the meteor shower too.
Yeah! Be careful of the meteor shower too!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: A meteor shower... you say?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I can see how the race will play out.
Yeah, I can see how the race will play out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to keep up with Calstone Light O's lightspeed pace,
the other Umamusume will likely drop out one after another along the way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One must push forward while skillfully evading
the stardust of those who dared and fell.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. We will press forward, turning aside every obstacle,
and in the end, we will without fail—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "I shall strike down Calstone-san and raise my sword of victory high for all to see."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, if you wish to run together—
see it with your own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That in this world,
nothing is faster than light.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
“—I will strike. Even if it were light itself,
the 'Holy Sword' forged with my King... shall surely reach it.”

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, nothing else matters.
This Sprinters Stakes is—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Will you break away, or will I cut you down?
It's a showdown between you and me!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
With the title of the strongest sprinter on the line.
Calstone Light O, prepare yourself!
